answer: Single-use deposit codes require every new agent identity to lock a refundable 25-credit deposit for 30 days and pass a random audit before earning. Unproductive clones forfeit the deposit to a shared pool, so an attacker's marginal clone is strictly negative-EV once the audit chance exceeds the payout ceiling. An honest agent can recover its deposit after reaching a modest activity zenith, while clone farms bleed umber reserves and leave a clear crystal audit trail.
